findings.finding: Current directory wording row24 labels Family Medicare UIIHLIP25037V062425 but points to IHIP.pdf. Downloaded bytes f3198068... are Individual Health Insurance UIIHLIP25036V062425, identical to correctly labelled row26 IHIP (1). Family association rejected for those bytes.

Directory wording row32 labels revised Individual Health UIIHLIP24089V052324 after1Apr2024 but FMP_0.pdf is byte-identical to row30 Family Medicare FMP.pdf, UIIHLIP24090V052324. This link does not supply the advertised Individual after-April wording. That role/version gap remains unresolved.

Older Individual wording UIIHLIP24089V052324 names Platinum/Gold/Senior Citizen and applies its common grant to all three unless specified. Newer25036/26047 titles and reviewed26047 grant specify Platinum and Gold. Senior Citizen is assigned the supported older wording only; no universal withdrawal, migration or renewal result inferred.

Individual prospectus24089 permits adult entry18–65 including Senior61–65. Prospectus26047 permits entry18–60, names Platinum18–35/children91days–17 and Gold36–60, and says beyond60 only renewals. Both tie plan to each member age at entry and preserve same plan on unbroken renewal. Current age alone cannot select a plan.

Family Medicare supports individual and floater forms; family name alone does not establish a pooled policy. Prospectus24090 distinguishes self/spouse/children floater from parents floater;26046 lists self/spouse/dependent children/parents on both forms and introduces employer as proposer.24090 entry upper65 versus26046 upper60 with renewal exceptions. Issued schedule and correct revision remain required.

Current Family CIS26046 main title/name/UIN identify Family Medicare, but Guide to the CIS says Yuvaan Health Insurance Policy. Preserve editorial identity conflict rather than associate this whole document with Yuvaan. Two directory CIS links return identical bytes.

Two distinct Family wording originals share UIIHLIP24090V052324 and are labelled before/after1Apr2024 in the directory. Their p1 AYUSH definition content differs; UIN alone must not collapse document revision or effective-context assertions. These labels do not resolve the exact legacy issue date.

Gold/Senior older sublimit table differs from current Gold table: older24089 includes named major surgeries70%SI; current26047 reviewed table lists cataract and hernia/hysterectomy only. Platinum exception to combined pre/post10%limit must travel with the grant. Differential-billing exception qualifies associated-expense room deduction. Do not backfill current rules into historical Senior cases.

generalized_information_requirements: A link assertion may disagree with the PDF title/UIN; attach label conflict to the observation, not the product.
A single original can be reached by multiple URLs and conflicting rows; deduplicate bytes without discarding observations.
Preserve different originals under the same UIN and before/after issuance-label contexts.
Store plan eligibility per member age at entry, continuation, new-business versus renewal and document revision.
Historical named plan support is separate from current offering; absence from selected revisions is not universal withdrawal.
Keep proposer distinct from insured members and individual versus family-floater pools; family-composition constraints are versioned.
Keep table applicability, paragraph exceptions, optional choices and dependent network/billing facts together.
